reading: The Overview takes the title from the cards and #743's first definition from the work page: 'A Hosted Cosmology is a new substrate class in the Crimson Hexagonal Architecture, distinct from Rooms, Chambers, Vaults, and Fields' becomes 'distinct from standard rooms, vaults, or fields' (chambers dropped). 'Published in May 2026' is #743's date line ('Date: May 2026'; record 2026-05-19). The 'Global Research Space' to which the piece is also credited is the TGRS aggregator card, which lists the deposit; it is given as a co-publisher. 'Room Physics' is then defined from nothing in the cards: 'how symbolic or tactile objects (like a Velcro nativity scene) behave and relate'. #743 has no velcro nativity scene. Its title is an inversion of Warhol's Exploding Plastic Inevitable (1966), set out as a table in §1 (Name Derivation) — Exploding → Imploding ('Radiation → collapse; fame → interiority'), Plastic → Velcro ('Smooth → adhesive; disposable → clinging'), Inevitable → Nativity ('Secular fate → sacred birth; endpoint → origin') — and its physics are laws for hosting an artist's cosmology: Law 2, No Position C; Law 3, Velcro Adhesion; the Michaelic Operator σ_M. The fourth card carries σ_M's opening ('Michael is the angel of the scales') and the composition does not use it. The answer closes on the commercial reading the Amazon card supplies, a 'physical Velcro/felt nativity playset or advent calendar'.
